entities.name: Rytva
entities.description: A valkyrie shepherd of Starnheim, paired with Avtyr.

entities.name: Avtyr
entities.description: Valkyrie paired with Rytva, who clashed with and then worked with Niko.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker visitor from Theros who warned the Valkyries about Koma.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The Cosmos Serpent, who breached into Starnheim.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm of Kaldheim where valkyries dwell.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm where Niko was caught in a clash of warriors.

entities.name: Orhaft
entities.description: Whose magic guided Niko's journey through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Beings who oversee the passage of souls.

events.summary: Niko trapped Avtyr using a magical shard during the skirmish in Bretagard.
events.quote: they managed to trap the Valkyrie using a magical shard

events.summary: Niko journeyed through an Omenpath to Starnheim, where no mortal had ventured before.
events.quote: no mortal had ventured into the realm of Starnheim before

events.summary: Niko warned the Valkyries about Koma; Koma then breached into Starnheim.
events.quote: Koma manifested, breaching through the fabric of reality itself

events.summary: Niko, Rytva and Avtyr devised a plan using mirrors and illusions to redirect Koma through the portals.
events.quote: They orchestrated a risky strategy involving mirrors and illusions

events.summary: Niko and Avtyr drove Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
events.quote: drive Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock

relations.quote: warned the Valkyries of Kaldheim about the impending danger posed by Koma
